# Copilot Instructions

This is a production Flutter project.

Rules:

- Flutter Stable
- Riverpod
- GoRouter
- Material3

Coding Style:

- Feature First
- Reusable Widgets
- Stateless whenever possible
- Repository Pattern
- Provider Pattern

Never:

- Break project architecture
- Generate duplicate widgets
- Rename existing files

Always:

- Keep flutter analyze clean
- Update docs
- Small commits
- Enterprise level code
